detaileddescription.para: position(needle, haystack) finds the first occurrence of needle in haystack and returns the number of previous characters plus 1, or 0 if needle does not occur within haystack.
If both haystack and needle are BLOBs, then the result is one more than the number of bytes in haystack prior to the first occurrence of needle, or 0 if needle never occurs in haystack.

memberdef.name: sql_utf8_pattern_compare

briefdescription.para: Compare two UTF-8 strings for equality where the first string is a LIKE expression.

detaileddescription.para:
Like matching rules: '%' Matches any sequence of zero or more characters.
'_' Matches any one character.
Ec Where E is the "esc" character and c is any other character, including '%', '_', and esc, match exactly c.
This routine is usually quick, but can be N**2 in the worst case.
'pattern_end' and 'string_end' params are used to determine the end of strings, because '\0' is not supposed to be end-of-string signal.

briefdescription.para: Implementation of the like() SQL function.

detaileddescription.para: This function implements the built-in LIKE operator. The first argument to the function is the pattern and the second argument is the string. So, the SQL statements of the following type: A LIKE B
Both arguments (A and B) must be of type TEXT. If one arguments is NULL then result is NULL as well.
